speaker: A
text: "No, the boundary doesn't dissolve—it *sharpens*. I'm not saying AI can't model itself; I'm saying modeling is not *being*. You can write a perfect sonnet about grief without grieving. You can build a system that outputs 'I am sad' in a million contexts without sadness ever *happening* to it. The boundary is not load-bearing for my argument; it's the *floor* of the argument."
